purpose: Register the exact small sensory source graph before assigning dynamical or fitted weights
stage: Development source audit, specified after human reading of the source rows; not preregistered or held out
reading: All 22 CSVs, primary article Sec7, Sec28 and Sec35; current scope not every article section

specimen.dataset: Adult brain EM dataset of Zheng et al., as used by Christenson et al. 2024
specimen.releaseBoundary: The source article and these CSVs do not pin a FlyWire materialization version; do not silently substitute a current release

rules: Preserve IDs as strings; no floating point conversion
Use exact per-file column mapping and preserve raw headers and rows
Input files describe partner-to-seed observations; output files describe seed-to-partner observations
Retain count columns and compartments separately; their sum is an explicit descriptive calculation
Blank partner IDs remain unidentified observations and must not merge into a shared biological node
Repeated ordered-ID pairs are observations of a route, not additive new synapses
Disagreeing input/output counts remain separate; do not average or choose one silently
A missing route in thresholded incomplete tables is unreported, not a proved anatomical zero
Keep publication text, repository summary rows and detailed-row sums separately
Do not infer synaptic sign, fitted strength, time constants or phase from counts
Do not equate ten sampled cells with the paper's twelve model populations

declaredColumnException.outputs_tm5b_720575940627282584.csv: Header names Cell type and Indentifier are reversed relative to all displayed row values. Parse first column as identifier and second as label while preserving the exact raw row and header.
